name: investor-portal
description: Investor Installment Portal - admin-only investment & installment collection system (bKash tokenized checkout, SaaS-grade security)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --workspace server run dev" "npm --workspace client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace client run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace server run lint && npm --workspace client run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace client run typecheck
